claims.quote: Newer pharmacological therapies for weight loss show promise.

claims.text: tirzepatide: FDA-approved for OSA, not yet for OHS.
claims.quote: Glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists—such as tirzepatide—have been approved by the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for the treatment of OSA, although not yet for OHS.
